faq.title: We answer your questions
faq.intro: What families want to know most.

items.q: What is the minimum GPA to apply?
items.a: A minimum GPA of 4.0 in Elementary and 3.5 per subject in Middle and High School is required, along with an impeccable disciplinary record.

items.q: How much is the admissions test and how do I pay?
items.a: It costs $50.00 for Preschool and Elementary, and $60.00 for Middle and High School. Payment is requested via Banco General Online Banking.

items.q: What scores do I need on the tests?
items.a: The minimum score is 3.0 on the academic exam and 85 on the psychological test.

items.q: How soon do I get the results?
items.a: Results are shared within 3 business days, by phone.

items.q: How long do I have to finalize enrollment?
items.a: Once results are delivered, families have 5 business days to enroll.

items.q: What are your admissions office hours?
items.a: Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m., at Calle 5ta, Don Bosco.

items.q: From what age do you accept students?
items.a: From Prekínder and Kindergarten through High School, with bilingual formation at every level.
Through the Academic Platform, accessible from the Academic Platform button in the menu.

hero.title: Privacy Notice and Personal Data Protection
hero.intro: In compliance with Law 81 on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Panama, we detail how we collect, use and protect your information.

sections.title: 1. Identity and address of the data controller
content: Escuela Bilingüe Santo Domingo Savio, located at Calle 5ta, Don Bosco, Panama, is the data controller responsible for the processing of personal data collected through this website, our physical facilities and any other official means of communication.

Our institution is duly accredited by the Ministry of Education of Panama (MEDUCA) and operates under the tutelage of the Archdiocese of Panama, governed by the principles of Don Bosco's Preventive System and current Panamanian legislation.

sections.title: 2. Personal data we collect
content: In the exercise of our educational and administrative functions, we may collect the following categories of personal data:
Identification data: full name, date of birth, ID or passport number, nationality, gender.
Contact data: home address, landline and mobile phone numbers, personal and institutional email addresses.
Academic data: academic records, grades, report cards, previous study certificates, admission and psychological test results.
Family data: information on parents or legal guardians, including names, occupations, contact details, marital status and relevant family relationships for student care.

Health data: relevant medical information for the student's safety and well-being during their time at the institution, including allergies, pre-existing medical conditions, prescribed medications and emergency contacts.
Financial data: information related to enrollment fees, monthly tuition, admission tests and other educational services.
Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent and other usage information collected through cookies and similar technologies when using our website.

sections.title: 3. Purposes of data processing
content: The personal data we collect is used exclusively for the following legitimate purposes:

Provision of educational services: enrollment management, academic administration, communication with parents and guardians, issuance of certificates and official documents, and monitoring of each student's academic and formative performance.
Admission process: evaluation of applications, administration of psychological and academic tests, communication of results and enrollment formalization.
Institutional communication: sending of circulars, newsletters, school calendars, meeting notices, event notifications and other relevant information for the educational community.
Safety and well-being: basic and emergency medical care in the school nurse's office, student accident insurance management, and communication with emergency services when necessary.
Legal compliance: responding to requirements from competent administrative and judicial authorities, as established by Panamanian legislation.
Website improvement: anonymous statistical analysis of our website usage to optimize the browsing experience.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis for processing
content: The processing of personal data carried out by Escuela Bilingüe Santo Domingo Savio is based on the following legal grounds established in Law 81 on Personal Data Protection of Panama:
Informed consent of the data subject or their legal representatives, in the case of minors, granted at the time of enrollment and throughout the educational relationship.
Performance of the contractual relationship arising from the provision of educational services.
Compliance with legal obligations applicable to educational institutions recognized by MEDUCA.
Legitimate interest of the institution to ensure the safety, well-being and proper formation of students, as well as to communicate with the families that make up our educational community.
In the case of health data, additional explicit consent is required from parents or guardians, in strict compliance with Article 13 of Law 81.

sections.title: 5. Minors' data
content: We recognize the special protection that the personal data of children and adolescents deserve. In compliance with Article 20 of Law 81 and provisions on the protection of minors:

All processing of minors' data requires verifiable consent from their parents or legal guardians. Such consent is obtained at the time of enrollment and may be revoked at any time through a written request.
Student data is treated with strict confidentiality and is only accessible to teaching and administrative staff who require such information for the performance of their duties.

We do not share minors' data with third parties without the prior and explicit consent of their legal representatives, except in cases provided by law (medical emergencies, judicial requirements, etc.).

Photographs and videos of school activities that include students will only be published on our official channels (website, social media, printed materials) with prior authorization granted by parents or guardians through the corresponding image consent form.
Parents or guardians may exercise ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition) regarding the data of minors under their care at any time.

sections.title: 6. Data transfers
content: Escuela Bilingüe Santo Domingo Savio does not commercialize, sell or rent personal data to third parties under any circumstances. The only data transfers we carry out are strictly necessary to:
Comply with legal obligations before the Ministry of Education (MEDUCA) and other competent authorities.

Manage services contracted to third parties that act as data processors under strict confidentiality agreements, such as the online academic management platform, cloud storage services and email service providers.
Address medical emergencies, in which case only the necessary health information will be shared with the treating medical personnel.
Any other transfer will require the prior, informed and written consent of the data subject or their legal representatives.

sections.title: 7. Security measures
content: We implement technical, administrative and physical measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, alteration or destruction. These include:
Restricted access to physical and digital records, limited exclusively to authorized personnel who require such information for the performance of their duties.
Use of encryption protocols (HTTPS/TLS) for all communication between the user's browser and our website.
Storage of digital data on secure servers with access controls, firewalls and continuous monitoring.
Periodic training of our staff on Law 81 on Personal Data Protection and best practices in handling confidential information.
Confidentiality agreements with all teaching, administrative staff and service providers who have access to personal data.
Documented procedures for notifying data breaches to data subjects and the data protection authority, in compliance with Article 34 of Law 81.

sections.title: 8. Retention periods
content: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which they were collected and to address any applicable legal obligations:
Academic records: retained permanently for their historical and legal value, in compliance with MEDUCA provisions for educational institutions.
Contact and communication data: retained for the duration of the educational relationship and up to two years after its termination, unless the data subject requests their deletion earlier.
Financial data: retained for the statute of limitations for tax and commercial obligations established by Panamanian legislation (generally 5 years).
Browsing data and cookies: retained for a maximum of 13 months from collection.
Once retention periods expire, data is securely deleted or anonymized for statistical purposes.

sections.title: 9. ARCO Rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition)
content: Law 81 on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Panama grants data subjects the following rights, which may be exercised at any time:
Right of Access: to know what personal data we have recorded about you or the minor under your care, as well as the purposes of processing.
Right of Rectification: to request the correction of personal data that is inaccurate, incomplete or outdated.

Right of Cancellation: to request the deletion of personal data when it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, provided there is no legal obligation requiring its retention.
Right of Opposition: to object to the processing of personal data for specific purposes, such as sending non-essential informational communications.
Right of Portability: to request a copy of personal data in a structured and commonly used format.

To exercise any of these rights, the data subject or their legal representative must submit a written request at our facilities (Calle 5ta, Don Bosco, Panama, Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.) or via email addressed to our institutional address, accompanied by a copy of their ID or passport. The request will be addressed within a maximum of 10 business days, as established in Law 81.

sections.title: 10. Use of cookies and similar technologies
content: Our website uses first-party and third-party cookies to improve the browsing experience, anonymously analyze traffic and remember language preferences.
We use the following categories of cookies:
Strictly necessary cookies: essential for the operation of the website (such as the Spanish/English language selector). They do not require user consent.
Analytics cookies: allow us to understand how visitors interact with our site (pages visited, time spent, etc.). We use tools that anonymize IP addresses.
Preference cookies: remember user choices such as the selected language to display content in Spanish or English.

When you first visit our website, you will be presented with a cookie notice where you can accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies or configure your preferences. You can modify your cookie settings at any time from the corresponding section of our website. Additionally, most browsers allow you to manage cookie preferences from their settings options.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this notice
content: Escuela Bilingüe Santo Domingo Savio reserves the right to modify this Privacy Notice at any time to adapt it to legislative developments, jurisprudential criteria or changes in our data processing practices.

Any substantial modification will be communicated to data subjects through official communication channels (institutional email, circulars and/or prominent publication on this website) at least 15 days before its entry into force.
We recommend periodically reviewing this Privacy Notice to stay informed about how we protect your personal data. The date of last update is indicated at the beginning of this document.

sections.title: 12. Applicable law and jurisdiction
content: This Privacy Notice is governed by Law 81 of March 26, 2019 on Personal Data Protection of the Republic of Panama, its regulatory Executive Decree, and the provisions issued by the national data protection authority.

For any dispute arising from the processing of personal data, the parties submit to the jurisdiction of the competent courts of the Republic of Panama, without prejudice to the data subject's right to appeal to the corresponding data protection authority.

Escuela Bilingüe Santo Domingo Savio reaffirms its unwavering commitment to privacy, transparency and respect for the fundamental rights of all members of our educational community: students, families, teachers and collaborators.
